verdict.rationale: Asana markets 'Asana Dash' as an 'AI Chief of Staff' and AI Teammates with Work Graph context, implying instant Q&A over workspace content, but the evidence never describes an actual citation mechanism, answer format, or hands-on example of sourced answers. missing for 10: concrete documentation/demo of citation-backed answers, independent verification that answers reference specific workspace items, and detail on how the AI surfaces sources.
